title: Raccoon in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf back tails -->
  <path d='M62 68 Q72 72 74 82 Q70 84 66 80 L60 72 Z' fill='#e8483d'/>
  <path d='M62 68 Q72 72 74 82 Q70 84 66 80 L60 72 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8a96b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#d6dcec'/>

  <path d='M30 64 Q50 74 70 64 Q70 72 50 80 Q30 72 30 64 Z' fill='#e8483d'/>
  <path d='M30 64 Q50 74 70 64' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M36 72 Q50 78 64 72' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='9' fill='#6f7a99'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='9' fill='#6f7a99'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='5' fill='#c9a3b8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='5' fill='#c9a3b8'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#8a96b8'/>

  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='8' fill='#a3aecd'/>

  <path d='M28 40 Q38 34 50 40 Q62 34 72 40 Q72 52 60 52 Q50 56 40 52 Q28 52 28 40 Z' fill='#f2f5ff'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#4a4568'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='44' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#4a4568'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2a2740'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2a2740'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#d6dcec'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2a2740'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#8a96b8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 Q46 58 43 56' fill='none' stroke='#4a4568' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 53 Q54 58 57 56' fill='none' stroke='#4a4568' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes on forehead -->
  <path d='M42 28 Q50 24 58 28' fill='none' stroke='#4a4568' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a4568'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a4568'/>
</svg>
